note: Ship weapons (brief §6, §7). power: bars it needs. charge: seconds to ready a shot. flight: seconds the shot is in the air. damage: hull points, and system bars from S2.2. pierce: extra brace units it takes to stop (S2.8, D-075). ammo: { magazine } for a heavy gun that fires rounds carried up from the hold, one round a shot (S2.8, D-076); none for a gun that needs no rounds. effects: chances of fire and breach and harm to crew in the room, used from S2.2. mount: false marks a weapon no ship fits, such as a carrier drone's zap (S2.5).

items.name: Pulse laser
items.blurb: Cheap, quick, needs nothing but power. Stopped dead by a brace.

items.name: Slug thrower
items.blurb: A mass driver salvaged from a mining rig. Slow. Makes holes. Fed by hand, three slugs to a load.

items.name: Breaching lance
items.blurb: Burns through a brace as if it were half there. Hungry, and every shot is a cell someone carried up from the hold.

items.name: Drone zap
items.blurb: What a carrier's drone spits at you. One hull point, now and then, until a brace burns the drone out.
